The product branding (logo, 'AFP', 'Drip Irrigation Tape', and Persian company name) is authentic and consistent with the reference. There is exactly one commercial product roll visible. No people, split layouts, or impossible geometry are present. The score reflects the overall quality and identity match with minor tolerance for the visual representation of the tape thickness.
